name: Kings Park and Botanic Garden
description: Large urban bushland reserve in Perth offering views of honeyeaters, parrots, raptors, and seasonal migrants.

name: Lake Monger
description: Freshwater lake near Perth attracting ducks, swans, cormorants, and other waterbirds.

name: Rottnest Island
description: Offshore island with seabirds, terns, shearwaters, and coastal specialists.

name: Shark Bay
description: World Heritage coastal site supporting shorebirds, seabirds, and arid-zone species.

name: Kakadu National Park
description: Extensive wetlands and floodplains hosting one of Australia’s richest bird communities.

name: Yellow Water Billabong
description: Iconic billabong in Kakadu famous for waterbirds, kingfishers, and birds of prey.

name: Daintree Rainforest
description: Ancient tropical rainforest home to endemic species including cassowaries and riflebirds.

name: Cairns Esplanade
description: Internationally significant mudflat and mangrove site for migratory shorebirds.

name: Atherton Tablelands
description: Upland forests and wetlands supporting many Queensland endemic birds.

name: Lamington National Park
description: Subtropical rainforest park known for lyrebirds, bowerbirds, and parrots.

name: Blue Mountains National Park
description: Eucalypt forests and escarpments supporting cockatoos, honeyeaters, and raptors.

name: Royal National Park
description: Coastal bushland south of Sydney with seabirds, forest birds, and migratory species.

name: Murramarang National Park
description: Coastal forests and beaches supporting a wide variety of bird species.

name: Barmah–Millewa Forest
description: River red gum forest critical for waterbirds, parrots, and woodland species.

name: Western Treatment Plant (Werribee)
description: One of Australia’s most important wetland sites for shorebirds and waterfowl.

name: Cradle Mountain–Lake St Clair National Park
description: Alpine and temperate habitats hosting several Tasmanian endemic birds.

name: Freycinet National Park
description: Granite peaks and coastal environments supporting seabirds and forest birds.

name: Coorong National Park
description: Lagoon and saltmarsh system vital for migratory shorebirds.

name: Flinders Ranges
description: Arid mountain ranges supporting emus, raptors, and desert-adapted birds.

name: Booderee National Park
description: Coastal forests and heathlands rich in honeyeaters and seabirds.

name: Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary
description: Mangrove sanctuary on Chorao Island known for herons, egrets, and kingfishers.

name: Carambolim Lake
description: Freshwater lake attracting migratory ducks, jacanas, and wading birds.

name: Cotigao Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Dense forest sanctuary home to hornbills, trogons, and forest passerines.
